instruction.name: xvssrlrn.w.d
instruction.description: Logical right shift with rounding each unsigned 64-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 64, saturate the result to signed 32-bit, write it into the lower half of each 128-bit lane of `dst`, and zero the upper half.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric.
